Thanks again for taking the time today — really useful call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a proforma over to you this week:

- Expected monthly token volume: 150M – 450M tokens (spikey – daily peak expected around 30M tokens)
- Primary workload: short completion + few long-context retrievals (2–4k tokens/session)
- Target: procurement looking for cost guidance at the ~$X / 1M-token range (you indicated $700–$1,000/1M as a target band)

What I’m sending now (attached):
- Pulse_Usage_Model.xlsx — blank usage model to capture monthly/day-of-week distribution (fill and return)
- redwood_pricing_calculator.csv — quick calculator for hosted vs. dedicated estimates

Proposed next steps
1) You fill the usage model with expected daily distribution → return by Tue 2026-01-20
2) We’ll generate two proforma options: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) and Dedicated (reserved capacity + burst) with sample $/1M token unit economics and estimated monthly invoice
3) Short call to review proforma + procurement questions (20–30m) — propose Wed 2026-01-21 10:00am PT; flag if another time works

If PulseHealth has a procurement template or other billing/legal contacts, please loop them in. I’ll also include a draft invoice estimate once we have the filled model.

Best,

Alyssa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Got your filled usage model (nice detail) — attaching a draft proforma and a filled copy of your model for transparency. Highlights below.

Attachments included:
- redwood_invoice_estimate_v1.pdf — two proforma lines (Pilot hosted, 12mo committed Dedicated) with monthly estimates
- Pulse_Usage_Model_Filled.xlsx — your model populated with hourly/daily distributions you provided

High-level cost sketch (examples; see attached pdf for line-item breakdown)
- Pilot (Hosted) — 30 day estimate
  - Monthly tokens: 160M (as provided)
  - Effective blended rate after batching/cache: $950 / 1M tokens
  - Monthly invoice: ~$152,000

- 12mo Committed (Dedicated) — steady state
  - Monthly tokens: 350M (projected steady state)
  - Effective blended rate after cache/quantization work: $680 / 1M tokens
  - Monthly invoice: ~$238,000 (note Dedicated includes reserved vCPU/GPU carveout; line items in pdf)

Notes and assumptions
- Batching/cache savings modeled at 12–18% for the long tail of short sessions; heavier long-context sessions assume higher per-token cost
- Dedicated scenario assumes 3-month ramp to steady state and a 12-month commitment; discounts structured around committed spend bands (documented in the pdf)
- Onboarding credit: we can propose a one-time $20k credit for pilot to offset initial setup; Sergio (cc’d) will confirm approval steps

Next steps
- Sergio to confirm whether we can offer the $20k onboarding credit for the pilot (cc’d)
- Alyssa / procurement to confirm timeline for internal finance review and any contracting constraints
- If that looks good, let’s lock a 30m review on Wed 1/21 to walk through the pdf line-by-line — I can send a calendar invite to confirm.

Thanks — happy to walk through any line-item.

Jasmine
